symptom: On a Mendix 9.0.0 or 9.0.1 project `mxcli check -p` passed `create workflow` (and `create or modify workflow`), and exec then refused it at write time ("cannot store … Workflows$Workflow (Mendix 9.0.2+)", or, for a workflow with a parameter, the 9.6–9.18 Workflows$Parameter properties) after the statements before it; `alter workflow`'s hint said "upgrade your project to Mendix 9.12+"
cause: sdk/versions workflows.basic was typed as 9.0.0 when Workflows$Workflow is 9.0.2 in mendixmodelsdk 4.117.0, and the CreateWorkflowStmt case of statementVersionGates applied only the sub-feature gates; only AlterWorkflowStmt applied basic, with a comment and hint naming 9.12, a third version
file: `mdl/executor/version_gates.go` (workflowBasicGate, the CreateWorkflowStmt and AlterWorkflowStmt cases); `sdk/versions/mendix-9|10|11.yaml` (workflows.basic 9.0.2); `mdl/executor/version_gates_workflow_actions_1787_test.go` (pinned in TestTypeGates_FloorIsTheTypeIntroduction)
insight: **A `basic` row is a floor like any other, so pin it to the type the statement writes.** It looked exempt because 9.0.0 is the bottom of supported_range and the gate could never fire, which is also why nobody noticed that `create workflow` had no basic gate at all: a gate that cannot fire and a missing gate behave the same until the floor moves. **A hint that names a version is a second copy of the floor**, and this one disagreed with both the row (9.0.0) and the type (9.0.2); checkFeature already puts the registry's version in the message, so a hint should say what to do, not when. Measured on a 9.24.30 app whose _MetaData version was set to 9.0.1.0 (no 9.0.x mxbuild is cached; the gate and the write read only that field): before, check -p passed and exec created the microflow and refused the workflow at write time; after, check -p and the pre-flight report MDL-VERSION01 for create, create or modify and alter workflow, and App.mpr is byte-identical. Control: the row moved back to 9.0.0 fails the pin test ("available at 9.0.1, where the write refuses [Workflows$Workflow]") and the gate test; the create case without workflowBasicGate fails the gate test for both create forms. The same stamped run shows how much more is refused below 9.12 that no gate names, all by property floors: `create module` (Projects$ModuleSettings.ProtectedModuleType 9.12), `create entity` (ExportLevel 9.3) and a workflow parameter (Workflows$Parameter.Name 9.18)
